settings.saveHint: Use Save to apply your changes.
kodi.intro: Connect Kodi and your channel list. Your current channel will then be detected automatically.
kodi.connectionHint: Enter your Kodi address. Login details are only needed if you have set them up in Kodi.
kodi.channelsHint: The address of your M3U or M3U8 channel list. It refreshes regularly so new channels become available automatically.
kodi.networkHint: Kodi needs to reach this service to display uploaded placeholder images. Use an address on your network.
placeholder.intro: Choose what appears on your screen during an ad break.
placeholder.sourceHint: Upload your own image or use a file that Kodi can already access.
placeholder.imageHint: Upload a picture you like. It will be saved and selected as your placeholder right away.
placeholder.emptyPreview: Your uploaded image appears here when it is in use as the placeholder.
placeholder.filesHint: Enter file paths or URLs that Kodi can open, then choose your favorite.
logos.intro: Mark your channel's logo so automation can tell when the program is on.
logos.stepSelect: Draw a box around the logo
logos.emptyHeading: Ready for your first channel image
logos.emptyHint: Click “Load current image”, then mark the logo directly in the picture.
logos.libraryHint: Images with different backgrounds improve detection. Click an image to see its selection.
recognition.intro: Choose how quickly detection reacts and how long the program or placeholder stays protected.
recognition.detectionHint: More consecutive images make detection steadier. Fewer images mean a faster switch.
recognition.intervalHint: Time between two checks of the channel logo.
recognition.timingHint: Prevent playback from switching back and forth too quickly. Set either protection period to 0 to turn it off.
recognition.cooldownHint: After automatically returning, the program stays on for this period.
recognition.minimumHint: The placeholder stays visible for this long before automation can switch back.
recognition.pauseHint: Saves resources and resumes automatically afterwards.
recognition.advancedHint: A higher similarity value requires a closer match. Contrast strength helps when picture brightness changes.

language.label: Select language

status.heading: Your TV at a glance
status.description.attention: There is a connection or detection issue. You can find the details below.
status.description.manual: You switched on the placeholder. You decide when to continue.
status.description.waiting: Play a channel in Kodi. It will appear here once it is recognized.
status.description.setup: Select the channel logo under “Logo references” so detection can begin.
status.description.stopped: Automatic detection is off. You can start it again at any time.
status.description.advert: An ad break was detected. The placeholder is on until the program returns.
status.description.paused: Enjoy your program. Detection will resume automatically after the protection period.
status.description.watching: Detection is watching the channel logo and will switch when an ad break starts.
status.manualNotice: The placeholder stays on until you switch back to the channel or resume automation.
status.cooldownNotice: Protection for another {time}: playback will not switch to the placeholder during this time.
status.minimumNotice: The placeholder will stay on for at least another {time}.
status.offlineHint: The status could not be updated. Displayed values may be out of date. The connection will be checked again automatically.

placeholder.selectImage: Select JPG, PNG, GIF, WebP or BMP
logos.heading: Show us the channel logo
logos.description: Each selection is assigned to the currently saved channel. Multiple examples with different image backgrounds improve detection. Click a saved reference to mark its position in the preview image. Use “Remove empty borders” to cautiously trim a rough selection.
logos.noSelection: Draw a box around the channel logo.
logos.noReferences: No references for this channel yet.
logos.showPosition: Show this reference's position in the image
recognition.heading: Make automation work for you
recognition.missingFrames: Images without logo before ad break
recognition.description: 0 disables the respective lock. The program lock prevents switching to the placeholder; when enabled, pausing stops the detector until the lock ends and then restarts it automatically. The minimum time prevents returning to the channel too early. Contrast strength emphasizes logo structure when image brightness changes; the logo's edge shape is compared as well.
alerts.noFrame: No image from the stream yet. Check the status for an FFmpeg error.
alerts.selectArea: Select an area in the image first.
